gates.threshold: survey, ownership, heritage, fire, accessibility and provisional-boundary limits are logged; exact 100 m alignment remains removable
all accountable, responsible, consulted and informed roles plus six cost ledgers have an owner and funding source
seven public rights, minimum-data record, no-app equivalent, accessible route and deletion trigger are complete
4 of 4 fixtures match expectation and all 3 negative fixtures fail closed
zero unresolved critical accessibility barriers, 100 percent high-risk outputs human-confirmed, severe safety or privacy incidents equal zero
claims, incidents, complaints, maintenance, data deletion and public feedback are published before continue, modify or sunset

data_lifecycle.rule: publish purpose, fields, source, accountable role, retention and human checkpoint before collection
public, cleared or synthetic model-test data only; no default biometrics or device identifiers
voluntary feedback only; no-app and staffed routes remain equivalent; raw voluntary feedback default maximum is 7 days
role-based access log, source-integrity check, human confirmation of all high-risk outputs and incident triage
only non-identifying aggregates, claim provenance, incident status and repair evidence enter the public registry
withdrawal triggers deletion before the next gate and no later than 24 hours; portable audit export precedes vendor exit

acceptance_measures.threshold: 100% acknowledged within 1 working day; at least 90% resolved or given a reasoned decision within 10 working days

affordability_floor.rule: basic passage, safety information, consultation, complaint and appeal must not require a purchased device, subscription, account or extra fee
affordability_floor.funding_condition: the future operator must identify funding for staffed, accessible and non-digital equivalents before G4; this is a proposed admission condition, not a current government promise

rollback: freeze the AI function immediately while keeping the staffed or non-AI route open
preserve a minimum incident record without expanding personal-data collection
delete or quarantine affected raw records according to the published trigger
restore the prior public-space arrangement and portable service interface
publish a preliminary notice, repair evidence and a continue-modify-sunset decision

g5_completion_receipt.incomplete_action: sunset_or_repair_evidence_only; no scaling or silent restart
